name: CogniCore
description: Persistent agent memory across runs: record verified outcomes, recall them in later sessions, and reflect on recurring patterns.
notes: Runs a local MCP server over stdio; install with `pip install "cognicore-env[mcp]"`. Memories are stored in a SQLite database at `COGNICORE_DATA_DIR` (default `~/.cognicore/mcp/mcp_memories.db`). Point that variable at a mounted volume, or memory is discarded when a sandbox is recreated. Stored entries carry `state: candidate`; the released server exposes no tool that promotes an entry to a trusted state, so callers should re-verify a recalled value before acting on it. For the same reason, treat recall as a hint rather than as a verified fact.

envFields.label: Memory directory
envFields.helperText: Directory holding the memory database. Set this to a path that persists between runs; the default under the home directory is discarded when a sandbox is recreated.

installHint: Requires the uv package manager on PATH, since uvx launches the server. No API key is required. Set COGNICORE_DATA_DIR to a path that survives between runs; otherwise recorded memories are lost with the sandbox.
